punchline: The Dalai Lama asked Cutler whether he helped 70 percent of his patients, and said that was enough.
thirty_sec: Psychiatrist Howard Cutler told the Dalai Lama that difficult patients made him feel incompetent. The Dalai Lama asked if he could help 70 percent of them; when Cutler said yes, he replied that there was no problem, and that helping only 30 percent might call for another profession.
question: Which one difficult case has been shaping how you judge your work, and what does your wider record say?
key_contrast: Judge yourself by the rate across all your cases, not the hardest one.
